summary: TPG Twin Brook Capital Income Fund filed an 8-K reporting that its indirect wholly-owned subsidiary, Twin Brook Capital Funding XXXIII SMPV, LLC, entered a new SMBC Warehouse Facility on September 28, 2026, with Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation as administrative agent and Computershare as collateral agent. The facility carries an initial maximum senior commitment of $362.5 million, secured by commercial loans, priced at adjusted term SOFR plus 1.85% during reinvestment and plus 2.35% thereafter, terminating on the six-month anniversary with two six-month extensions, maturing the earlier of a CLO closing or September 28, 2029.
